mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and 64 degree temperatures over the Military Ridge State Trail. The overnight low will be 58 degrees, with no rain expected.

In city news, Verona is preparing for the November general election with various public notices now available. Additionally, the city continues to contract with AECOM for ongoing engineering services, with detailed reports available on the city website.

There is plenty to do, starting with yoga at Insight Wellness and trivia at Hop Haus occurring today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, leading up to the excitement of the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival in Verona this Saturday.

In a report from the police department, officers arrested a 34-year-old Madison woman on Friday, September 4, for sexual assault of a child by a school staff member for actions reported to have occurred in 2019.

Today's flavor of the day was Dark Chocolate Decadence. The Culver's in Verona is currently closed for the night, so please join them tomorrow when they open at 10:00 AM to enjoy the new flavor of the day, Raspberry Cheesecake.
